日文.首段: 阪神110形電車（はんしん110がたでんしゃ）は、阪神電気鉄道が1987年に導入した事業用の鉄道車両で、用途は救援車である。旧性能小型車を改造した救援車153号の代替として製造された。

章节.概要:
小型車1141形1145号から改造された旧性能救援車の153形153号は、阪神で最後まで残った旧小型車となっていた。この153号の老朽化に伴う代替として、1987年（昭和62年）に救援車として110形110号が武庫川車両工業で製造された。153号は自走可能な電動車であったが、110形は自車に動力を持たない制御貨車とすることで保守の低減が図られた。
なお、110という車号は、初代の有蓋電動貨車である101形から数えると4代目になる。2代目以降の110号はいずれも救援車である。
章节.車体:
車体長は17.7 m、車体幅は2.74 mで、両運転台の切妻車体となっている。前面中央部に貫通扉を設け、側面には片側2カ所に2.0 m幅の機材搬出入用引戸を設けたほか、固定窓を片側2箇所に設けた。車内には155形と同様荷物棚を置くなどして救援資材を積み込んでいるほか、車内にホイストを取り付けている。屋根にはグローブ型ベンチレーターが2つ搭載されている。
塗装は新造時よりジェットカーのウルトラマリンブルーがベースとなり、妻面には赤胴車のバーミリオンの帯が配された。
章节.主要機器: 台車は直角カルダン方式のFS-206を電装解除したFS-206Tであったが、後年になりFS341台車に換装された。ブレーキ装置は営業車との併結を考慮してHSC電磁直通ブレーキを採用、連結器はバンドン式密着連結器である。
章节.運用:
110は尼崎車庫に常駐しており、緊急時以外は車庫の22番線に留置されている。自車には動力を持たず、出動時は電動車と連結して現場に向かう。併結する車両はHSCブレーキの在来車となっており、末期は在来車の廃車により併結可能な営業車は7861・7961形のみとされていた。
検査出場時等の試運転で日中の西大阪線(現・阪神なんば線)を走ることもあったが、阪神なんば線の開業後は営業列車の増発で試運転列車の設定が困難となり、以後は尼崎車庫内の構内試運転に変更された。
2017年（平成29年）12月1日付で廃車となり、解体された。

中文.首段: 阪神110型电车（はんしん110がたでんしゃ）是阪神电气铁道于1987年引进的业务用铁路车辆，用途为救援车。它是作为由旧性能小型车改造而成的救援车153号的替代车辆而制造的。

章节.概要:
由小型车1141型1145号改造而成的旧性能救援车153型153号，是阪神最后保留的旧小型车。作为该153号老化后的替代，1987年（昭和62年）由武库川车辆工业制造了作为救援车的110型110号。153号是可自行行走的电动车，而110型则采用自身无动力的控制货车形式，以求降低维护。
另外，“110”这一车号，从初代有盖电动货车101型算起已是第4代。第2代以后的110号均为救援车。
章节.车体:
车体长17.7米、车体宽2.74米，为双端驾驶台的切妻式（平头）车体。车头中央部设贯通门，侧面每侧设2处2.0米宽的器材搬出入用推拉门，另每侧设2处固定窗。车内与155型一样设置行李架等以装载救援器材，并在车内安装有起重葫芦（Hoist）。车顶搭载2个球型（Globe型）通风器。
涂装自新造时起即以Jet Car的群青色（Ultramarine blue）为基调，端面配以红车（赤胴車）的朱红色带。
章节.主要机器: 转向架原为将直角卡尔丹方式的FS-206解除电装后的FS-206T，后来更换为FS341转向架。制动装置考虑到与营业车辆并结，采用了HSC电磁直通制动；连接器为万隆式（Bandung式）密着连接器。
章节.運用:
110号常驻于尼崎车库，除紧急情况外停放于车库的22号线。自身无动力，出动时与电动车连结前往现场。与其并结的车辆为采用HSC制动的既有车，末期由于既有车报废，可并结的营业车辆仅限7861、7961型。
在检修出厂等的试运转时，本车也曾于白天的西大阪线（现阪神难波线）行驶；但阪神难波线开业后，因营业列车增发导致难以安排试运转列车，此后改为在尼崎车库内的场内试运转。
2017年（平成29年）12月1日予以报废并解体。

木下和弘《阪神电气铁道 现有车辆Profile 2017》《铁道Pictorial》（特集：阪神电气铁道）2017年12月临时增刊号（No.940），电气车研究会。pp.211-282

英文.首段: The Hanshin 110 series electric car (Hanshin 110-gata densha) is a departmental railway vehicle introduced by Hanshin Electric Railway in 1987, used as a rescue car. It was built as a replacement for rescue car No. 153, which had been converted from an old-performance small car.

章节.Overview:
Rescue car No. 153 of the 153 type, converted from small car No. 1145 of the 1141 type, had been the last surviving old small car on Hanshin. To replace No. 153 as it aged, No. 110 of the 110 series was built as a rescue car by Mukogawa Sharyō Kōgyō in 1987 (Shōwa 62). No. 153 was a self-propelled motor car, but the 110 series was made a control freight car with no motive power of its own, in order to reduce maintenance.
The car number 110 is the fourth generation counting from the 101 series, the first covered electric freight car. All No. 110s from the second generation onward have been rescue cars.
章节.Car body:
The body is 17.7 m long and 2.74 m wide, with a double-ended flat-end (kirizuma) body. A gangway door is provided in the center of the front, and on each side two 2.0 m wide sliding doors for loading and unloading equipment were provided, as well as two fixed windows per side. Inside, as with the 155 series, luggage racks were installed to carry rescue materials, and a hoist was fitted inside the car. Two globe-type ventilators are mounted on the roof.
The livery has been based on the Jet Car's ultramarine blue since construction, with a vermilion stripe of the red-bodied cars (akadōsha) on the end faces.
章节.Main equipment: The bogies were originally FS-206T, the FS-206 right-angle Cardan type with motorization removed, but in later years they were replaced with FS341 bogies. For the braking system, an HSC electromagnetic direct brake was adopted in consideration of coupling with revenue cars, and the couplers are Bandung-type tight-lock couplers.
章节.Operation:
No. 110 is stationed at Amagasaki Depot and, except in emergencies, is stabled on track No. 22 of the depot. It has no motive power of its own and, when dispatched, couples to a motor car to head to the scene. The cars it couples with are conventional cars with HSC brakes, and in its final years, as conventional cars were withdrawn, the only revenue cars it could couple with were the 7861 and 7961 series.
On test runs after inspections, it sometimes ran on the Nishi-Osaka Line (now the Hanshin Namba Line) during the daytime, but after the opening of the Hanshin Namba Line it became difficult to schedule test trains because of increased revenue services, so thereafter it was changed to yard test runs within Amagasaki Depot.
It was withdrawn on December 1, 2017 (Heisei 29) and dismantled.

英文.全文:
The Hanshin 110 series electric car (Hanshin 110-gata densha) is a departmental railway vehicle introduced by Hanshin Electric Railway in 1987, used as a rescue car. It was built as a replacement for rescue car No. 153, which had been converted from an old-performance small car.

== Overview ==
Rescue car No. 153 of the 153 type, converted from small car No. 1145 of the 1141 type, had been the last surviving old small car on Hanshin. To replace No. 153 as it aged, No. 110 of the 110 series was built as a rescue car by Mukogawa Sharyō Kōgyō in 1987 (Shōwa 62). No. 153 was a self-propelled motor car, but the 110 series was made a control freight car with no motive power of its own, in order to reduce maintenance.
The car number 110 is the fourth generation counting from the 101 series, the first covered electric freight car. All No. 110s from the second generation onward have been rescue cars.

=== Car body ===
The body is 17.7 m long and 2.74 m wide, with a double-ended flat-end (kirizuma) body. A gangway door is provided in the center of the front, and on each side two 2.0 m wide sliding doors for loading and unloading equipment were provided, as well as two fixed windows per side. Inside, as with the 155 series, luggage racks were installed to carry rescue materials, and a hoist was fitted inside the car. Two globe-type ventilators are mounted on the roof.
The livery has been based on the Jet Car's ultramarine blue since construction, with a vermilion stripe of the red-bodied cars (akadōsha) on the end faces.

=== Main equipment ===
The bogies were originally FS-206T, the FS-206 right-angle Cardan type with motorization removed, but in later years they were replaced with FS341 bogies. For the braking system, an HSC electromagnetic direct brake was adopted in consideration of coupling with revenue cars, and the couplers are Bandung-type tight-lock couplers.

== Operation ==
No. 110 is stationed at Amagasaki Depot and, except in emergencies, is stabled on track No. 22 of the depot. It has no motive power of its own and, when dispatched, couples to a motor car to head to the scene. The cars it couples with are conventional cars with HSC brakes, and in its final years, as conventional cars were withdrawn, the only revenue cars it could couple with were the 7861 and 7961 series.
On test runs after inspections, it sometimes ran on the Nishi-Osaka Line (now the Hanshin Namba Line) during the daytime, but after the opening of the Hanshin Namba Line it became difficult to schedule test trains because of increased revenue services, so thereafter it was changed to yard test runs within Amagasaki Depot.
It was withdrawn on December 1, 2017 (Heisei 29) and dismantled.
